item.title: Jane: Instantiation RCE via parameter description - raw PHPDoc / breakout (jane-php/open-api-3)
item.description: Jane is a set of PHP libraries that generates models and API clients from JSON Schema and OpenAPI specifications. Prior to 7.12.0, the Jane open-api-3 generator emits an OpenAPI parameter description verbatim in generated Client/Endpoint method docblocks. A parameter description containing a PHPDoc closing delimiter can terminate the comment early and place attacker-controlled PHP in class-body position, including…

item.title: CVE-2026-133968
item.description: monailabel (aka MONAI Label) before 0.8.6 allows directory traversal, with resultant remote code execution, via the image parameter to the PUT /datastore/image endpoint, as exploited in the wild starting in September 2026.

item.title: MailAssure / SpamExperts: Server-Side Request Forgery in relay LDAP synchronisation connection check
item.description: N-able MailAssure (SpamExperts) before 20261121.1943 does not restrict the destination of the LDAP synchronisation connection check performed when a relay is configured. An authenticated API user can cause the server to connect to arbitrary internal hosts and ports, determine which are reachable, and send crafted data to internal services.

item.title: isomorphic-git allows unbounded memory allocation from attacker-controlled delta target size (DoS)
item.description: Summary When applying a delta object from a packfile, isomorphic-git reads a server-controlled targetSize and calls Buffer.alloc(targetSize) with no upper bound. A single malicious HTTP response to git.clone() / git.fetch() can force a ~2 GB allocation → memory exhaustion / DoS (process killed on memory-constrained hosts). Details src/utils/applyDelta.js : js const sourceSize = readVarIntLE(reader) const targetSize…

item.title: jline3 leads to ReDoS in Built-in Less Viewer Search
item.description: Summary The JLine3 built-in less pager compiles user-supplied search patterns directly as Java regular expressions with no sanitization, timeout, or backtracking bound. A malicious pattern such as (a+)+b can trigger catastrophic backtracking and hang the session thread at 100% CPU. In deployments that expose less over Telnet or SSH, this becomes a denial-of-service issue for the affected session and can be used to…

The Montgomery ladder selects between point candidates with uint256…

item.title: Klever Go counts bitmap padding bits toward BLS quorum, allowing blocks with insufficient signatures
item.description: Summary When validating an incoming block header, HeaderSigVerifier.verifyConsensusSize counts every set bit in PubKeysBitmap — including bits that correspond to no validator (the padding bits of the final byte, which exist whenever the consensus group size is not a multiple of 8). The subsequent BLS aggregate-signature verification ( blsMultiSigner.Verify ) only checks signature validity for real validator indices…

item.title: i18next deepExtend recurses into inherited built-ins, allowing corruption of shared built-in objects (DoS)
item.description: Summary deepExtend in src/utils.js (reached via the public addResourceBundle(lng, ns, data, deep, overwrite) API) checked key existence with the in operator, which walks the prototype chain. A source key matching an inherited built-in (e.g. hasOwnProperty , toString , valueOf ) therefore caused the function to recurse into the shared object on Object.prototype . With overwrite: true , a nested value could overwrite…

item.title: Xen Orchestra: Empty-object login token
item.description: Summary REST cookie parsing turns authenticationToken=j:%7B%7D into {} . REST authentication passes that object to the XO token provider without requiring a string. The token collection treats {} as an unfiltered lookup and returns its first token; the provider authenticates as that token's owner if it is unexpired. The authenticated /rest/v0/users/me/authentication tokens route then returns reusable login token…

This CVE covers the same underlying vulnerability as CVE-2026-82384 but applies to a broader range of affected versions.
